verdict.rationale: The Snyk CLI is explicitly documented to run in CI/CD pipelines (snyk-gh-3) and to test code/dependencies with a terminal report of vulnerabilities (snyk-gh-4, snyk-gh-5), which supports the ci-precommit use case, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents exit-code-based build failure or per-pull-request triggering/gating configuration. missing for 10: explicit documentation of exit codes for CI failure, PR-triggered scan configuration/gating settings, and independent confirmation that builds actually fail on new findings.
